articles.title: Cameroon’s Top Banana Exporter PHP Posts CFA10.4 Billion in Losses Over Two Years
articles.description: Plantations du Haut Penja (PHP), Cameroon’s largest banana exporter, accumulated CFA10.4 billion in losses over 2024 and 2025, while its revenue fell by nearly a third last year despite only a slight decline in banana export volumes. PHP, the main Cameroon subsidiary of Compagnie Fruitière, posted a loss of €8.80 million, or about CFA5.78 billion, in 2025. That compares with €7.04 million, or CFA4.62 billion, in 2024. The annual loss therefore widened by about 25%. Revenue fell even more sharply. PHP recorded €87.39 million in revenue in 2025, down 32.4% from €129.25 million a year earlier. At the fixed exchange rate of CFA655.957 per euro, revenue dropped from about CFA84.8 billion to CFA57.3 billion, a decline of CFA27.5 billion. That fall contrasts with the company’s banana export volumes. PHP shipped 151,713 tons in 2025, only 1% below the 153,258 tons exported in 2024. PHP accounted for 151,713 tons of the 225,345 tons exported by Cameroon in 2025, or 67.3% of the volumes tracked by the Cameroon Banana Association.
